name: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building codes and permit requirements for window replacement can vary by city and specific project details within Orange County, California. Minor replacements often don't require a permit, especially if the opening size isn't changed. However, for significant structural alterations or new openings, a permit is typically necessary. We can help clarify specific requirements for your location and project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permit requirements vary in Orange County based on the city and project scope; minor replacements may not need one, but structural changes usually do.
